en.advanced_maintenance_bonus_tooltip: Bonus of supplied vehicles: fuel raises the top speed, furniture the comfort, machines lower noise and pollution, each by this much. Without a supply the vehicle runs with its normal value. Can be changed later in the mod settings of the savegame (mod selection before loading).
en.advanced_maintenance_duration_tooltip: Calendar days a full fuel supply lasts while the vehicle is moving. Furniture and machines last twice as long. Can be changed later in the mod settings of the savegame (mod selection before loading).
en.advanced_maintenance_per_unit_tooltip: Number of empty buses one cargo unit fully supplies. Trams, small ships, small aircraft and helicopters need twice as much as a bus, trains, large ships and large aircraft four times as much. Can be changed later in the mod settings of the savegame (mod selection before loading).
en.advanced_maintenance_capacity_tooltip: Units of each supply (fuel, furniture, machines) a depot, maintenance station or hangar can store. Deliveries stop when the storage is full. Applies to facilities built (or rebuilt) after the change.
en.advanced_maintenance_depot_no_stock: This facility has no supply stocks. It was built before the mod was added: rebuild it to accept fuel, furniture and machines.

zh_TW.advanced_maintenance_bonus_tooltip: 有補給的車輛依這個比例獲得加成：燃油提高最高速度，家具提高舒適度，機械降低噪音與污染。缺少某種補給時，對應的數值維持原本。之後可在讀取存檔前的模組設定中修改。
zh_TW.advanced_maintenance_duration_tooltip: 車輛行駛時，燃油補滿後可維持的日曆天數，家具與機械可維持 2 倍天數。之後可在讀取存檔前的模組設定中修改。
zh_TW.advanced_maintenance_per_unit_name: 每單位貨物可補滿的車輛數
zh_TW.advanced_maintenance_per_unit_tooltip: 一單位貨物可補滿幾輛空的公車。輕軌、小型船隻、小型飛機與直升機需要公車的 2 倍，火車、大型船隻與大型飛機需要 4 倍。之後可在讀取存檔前的模組設定中修改。
zh_TW.advanced_maintenance_capacity_tooltip: 車廠、維修站或機庫每種補給（燃油、家具、機械）最多可存放的單位數。存滿後不再收貨。只套用在變更後新建或重建的設施。
zh_TW.advanced_maintenance_depot_no_stock: 這座設施沒有補給庫存，它在加入模組前就已建好。拆除重建後才能收燃油、家具與機械。
